metadata.title: Constant Rank Theorems under Intermediate Ricci Curvature
metadata.abstract: We prove two constant rank theorems for the Ricci tensor in two geometric settings: manifolds with harmonic curvature and gradient Ricci solitons. In both cases, if the $k$-intermediate Ricci curvature satisfies $\Ric_k\geq0$ for some $1\leq k\leq n-2$, then the Ricci tensor has constant rank and its nullity distribution is parallel. In the complete case, the universal cover splits isometrically along the Ricci-null directions. We also show that the range $1\leq k\leq n-2$ is sharp: in every dimension $n\geq4$, nonnegative Ricci curvature alone does not imply the constant rank property in either setting.

analysis.progressType: 中间 Ricci 曲率下的常秩与分裂
analysis.workSummary: 对调和曲率流形及梯度 Ricci 孤子，证明非负 k-中间 Ricci 曲率在 1≤k≤n−2 时使 Ricci 张量常秩且零分布平行；完备时万有覆盖沿零方向等距分裂。并在每个 n≥4 的维度说明非负 Ricci 曲率本身不足以保证常秩。
analysis.breakthrough: 得到两类几何中同一曲率条件下的刚性，并以反例表明指标范围尖锐。
analysis.limitations: 要求调和曲率或梯度 Ricci 孤子结构；分裂需要完备性，不能只假设 Ric≥0。
